The Uninvited Transformation

During a family wedding reception, David slips away from the noisy celebration and hides in the off-limits bridal suite, hoping to enjoy a few quiet minutes alone with his phone. Instead, the unattended wedding gown and its accessories awaken with mysterious magic. One by one, the enchanted bridal garments replace his clothes and force themselves onto him—tights, veil, corseted dress, gloves, lace bolero, and heels—each piece becoming impossible to remove.

The magic does not stop at changing David’s outfit. It gradually reshapes his body, hair, and face until the terrified young man becomes a bridal copy of his own sister. Trapped inside the elaborate wedding ensemble and confronted by an unfamiliar reflection, David realizes that his uninvited transformation may be permanent.
